subject: Private environment demo — stakeholder availability & evidence request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cypresslabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick sync — Private deployment demo for Cypress Labs

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for signing up to evaluate Redwood for Private/VPC deployment. I’m Aditya on the SDR team — congrats on getting the self-serve trial started. I’d love to schedule a short 45-minute walkthrough focused on the on-prem/pilot workflow and compliance requirements.

Quick question on timing: do mornings this week (PDT) or early afternoons (EDT) work better for your team? If it helps I can propose two options:
- Tue 7/20 10:00–10:45 PDT (13:00–13:45 EDT)
- Wed 7/21 14:00–14:45 PDT (17:00–17:45 EDT)

I’ll include our solutions engineer Marcus and security engineer Karthik so we can answer any preflight evidence questions. Also, can you confirm whether your IT/security team wants to join the session? If so, please share email(s) or I can send an invite and an evidence packet in advance.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: cypress_sso_requirements.pdf (pdf) — sent as reference for the trial signup]
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cypresslabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@cypresslabs.com>, itsec@cypresslabs.com
Date: 2026-07-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Private deployment demo for Cypress Labs

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for reaching out. We’re excited to evaluate Redwood. Our security lead (itsec@cypresslabs.com) should be on the call too — they’ll want a quick walk-through of the private deployment topology and what data flows look like.

Availability: Wed 7/21 in the morning PT would be best for both engineering and security (prefer 9:00–11:30 PT). We can do 9:30 PT if that works.

Also, before a demo, can you share SOC2 summary and a short checklist of what we should expect for network/NAT/firewall configuration for an on-prem pilot? That helps speed up procurement and kickoffs.

Regards,
Sarah Jenkins
VP Product, Cypress Labs
sarah.jenkins@cypresslabs.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cypresslabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Private deployment demo for Cypress Labs

Perfect — Wed 7/21 09:30 PT works on our side. I’m going to tentatively hold that and add Marcus (SE) and Karthik (Security) to the invite.

Karthik — can you attach a SOC2 summary and a short deployment checklist we can send to Cypress in advance? Marcus — FYI we may need a brief runbook for the pilot (expected to be air-gapped at first).

I’ll send a calendar invite once we’ve confirmed a time with your security team.

Thanks,
Aditya

Thanks — I can join Wed 7/21 at 09:30 PT but have a hard blocker at 10:15 PT. If we keep the session to 45 minutes starting at 09:30 PT I’ll need to be briefed to hand off to Karthik for security questions.

Two requests before the demo:
- Can Cypress share a single contact who will be the technical point of contact for the pilot and any IP allowlist details (public IP range or jump host)?
- I’m attaching a short deployment checklist I typically share ahead of pilot kickoffs. It includes network ports, cert expectations, and a minimal test dataset we use for on-prem smoke tests.

[Attachment: deployment-checklist.xlsx]

If 09:30→10:15 PT is tight, we can also push to 10:30 PT but I realize Sarah asked for morning. Aditya — can you confirm the exact end time we are comfortable with so Marcus can plan?

—Marcus

marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 summary & network preflight items

Hi Sarah/Tom —

Attached is a one-page SOC2 summary and a short list of items we typically collect before an on-prem pilot. The list covers:
- Network topology (NATs/jump hosts),
- TLS cert approach and CA requirements,
- Minimum outbound allowances for telemetry/metrics,
- Data-at-rest encryption notes and KMS integration patterns.

If your security team prefers, we can also set up a 20-minute preflight call to walk the items line-by-line before the demo.

[Attachment: SOC2-type-2-summary.pdf]

Best,
Karthik
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Confirmed: Private deployment demo — Wed 7/21 09:30 PT (calendar invite + preflight)

Hi Sarah/Tom —

Thanks for lining this up. Confirming our demo for Wed, July 21 at 09:30–10:15 PT. I’ve created the calendar invite and included Marcus (SE) and Karthik (Security).

Preflight items we need from Cypress ahead of the session:
- Single technical POC email: please reply with name + best contact (we have Tom listed but confirm)
- Network allowlist / jump-host IPs (even ranges are fine)
- Any internal compliance paperwork you expect during pilot procurement (we can attach to the HubSpot deal record)

Attachments included in this thread for your convenience: SOC2 summary, SSO/requirements you uploaded during signup, and our deployment checklist for the pilot.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=private-demo-cypress-20260721
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/5682/deal/DEAL-5682-CL

If any of the security folks want a short 20-min preflight, we can do Tue 7/20 at 4:00 PT — let me know and I’ll add it.

Look forward to meeting —
Mina Haddad
Manager, Sales Engineering (West)
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0177
